title: Change a value in an array
explanation:
An array stores several values of the same type.
Each position has an index, starting at zero.

values[1] selects the second element, which is 4.
Adding 3 to it changes the array to {2, 7, 6}.

question.prompt: Which line adds 3 to the second value?
question.hint: Count positions from zero and choose an update that keeps the old value.

options.feedback:
Index 1 selects the second element.
The += operator adds to its current value.

Index 2 selects the third element.
The second element is at index 1.

The = operator replaces the old value.
Use += to add to the old value.
